categories.nameEs: Especialidades de Catering y Platos Calientes

products.nameEs: Papas Fritas Trufadas con Queso Parmesano
products.descriptionEs: Papas fritas doradas y crujientes rociadas con aceite de trufa aromático, queso parmesano recién rallado y hierbas finas.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy golden french fries tossed in aromatic truffle oil, freshly grated parmesan cheese, and fine herbs.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo jugosas fritas a la perfección, bañadas en nuestra salsa picante casera de la casa. Servidas con aderezo de queso azul y bastones de apio.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy chicken wings fried to perfection, tossed in our signature house spicy buffalo sauce. Served with blue cheese dressing and celery sticks.

products.nameEs: Sopa Casera de Pollo con Fideos
products.descriptionEs: Caldo de pollo reconfortante preparado desde cero con verduras frescas de la granja, pollo tierno desmenuzado y fideos de huevo.
products.descriptionEn: Comforting chicken broth prepared from scratch with farm-fresh vegetables, tender shredded chicken, and egg noodles.
Oven-roasted turkey, smoked ham, crispy bacon, romaine lettuce, ripe tomatoes, and herb mayo on freshly baked artisan sub bread.

products.nameEs: Panini de Pollo a la Parmesana
products.descriptionEn: Crispy breaded chicken cutlet, homemade marinara sauce, melted fresh mozzarella, and fresh basil pressed on ciabatta bread.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Roast Beef Estilo Deli
products.descriptionEn: Thinly sliced tender roast beef, aged provolone cheese, caramelized onions, and creamy horseradish spread on a crusty roll.
Grilled zucchini, roasted red peppers, and eggplant with crumbled goat cheese and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

products.nameEs: Plato Combinado de Carnes Frías Artesanales
products.descriptionEn: Premium selection of roast beef, turkey, honey-glazed ham, genoa salami, and a variety of fine cheeses. Perfect for gatherings and events.

products.nameEs: Ensalada César con Pollo a la Parrilla
products.descriptionEn: Crisp romaine lettuce, homemade garlic croutons, freshly grated parmesan cheese, and grilled chicken breast with craft Caesar dressing.
Fresh chunk light tuna mixed with light mayo, crisp celery, and red onion, wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla with lettuce and tomato.
Freshly squeezed lemonade naturally sweetened and blended with wild raspberry puree.
Freshly brewed black tea, lightly sweetened and served over ice with a lemon wedge.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas en el menú y alternativas sin gluten para varios de nuestros sándwiches.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian items and gluten-free alternatives for many of our sandwiches upon request.

faqs.qEs: ¿Ofrecen servicio de catering para eventos y oficinas?
faqs.qEn: Do you provide catering services for events and offices?
faqs.aEs: ¡Absolutamente! Ofrecemos charolas de sándwiches, ensaladas y paquetes personalizados para todo tipo de eventos.
faqs.aEn: Absolutely! We provide sub platters, salads, and custom catering packages for all types of events and corporate meetings.
